premises.text: Mobile aspects of invoice/business management are not properly addressed for businesses on the go
premises.evidence_span: the mobile aspect of it was not being properly addressed

premises.text: A cloud-powered business management tool with a consistent mobile UI lets users fully manage the business from one backend
premises.evidence_span: fully integrated cloud-powered business management tool with a consistent user interface on all mobile operating systems

premises.text: Deep integrations with major accounting and B2B platforms (QuickBooks, Xero, TradeShift, etc.) are required for broad reach
premises.evidence_span: fully integrated with as many accounting platforms as possible and integrated with the leading B2B platforms

premises.text: Mobile invoices need richer documentation via picture, audio, and geotag attachments, especially photos as proof of work/delivery
premises.evidence_span: lack of documentation, not just in normal invoicing, but in mobile invoicing

premises.text: Saving an invoice instantly archives to the cloud, syncs to connected platforms, and returns a shareable customer URL
premises.evidence_span: it instantly jumps to our cloud, archives all the data, and if it's connected to another platform, it will write it

premises.text: Freemium commercial model: free unlimited invoices/estimates; $7/user/month for storage and payment; $10 to attach accounting/B2B
premises.evidence_span: The app itself is free. You can send unlimited invoices and sales estimates

premises.text: Enterprise readiness via sales orders supports OMS-style use beyond simple invoices
